name: 公主无诏
overview: Reborn three years before her death, Princess Linchuan is determined to atone for the  mistakes of her past life. Branded by her former cruelty, she adopts a ruthless façade to secretly protect her prince consort, Yun Zheng. As betrayal, sacrifice, and misunderstanding drive them apart, fate brings them back together under new identities, forcing them to confront buried truths and unresolved emotions.
